game.name: Create (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Create on 360 is a highly family-friendly puzzle game. The objective is to imagine and design your own levels, improvise solutions, all to unlock a whole host of rewards. Sharing "scenes" (and posting solutions online at www.create.ea.com) is one of the strengths of Create, which presents itself as a LittleBigPlanet-like game. Paintings, textures, elements and animated objects can be used to create challenges in addition to the hundred or so that are offered at the start.
